description:
[h1]Frostsworn — Slay the Spire 2 Character Mod[/h1]
[b]Freeze your enemies. Store your next turn's winning play in the cold.[/b]

[b]AI disclosure: AI tools were used to create this mod's code and artwork, including code generation and revision, as well as generation, editing, and completion of some art assets.[/b]

[b]Artists and animators urgently needed >_<[/b] Interested? Get in touch through the comments or GitHub!

Frostsworn is an ice mage built around control, preparation, and bursts of frost magic. Freeze enemies with Frost, conjure Ice Crystals, or put cards into Cold Storage for a stronger turn ahead. Ice Armor and Snowfall support your defense and offense, while Self-Frost makes powerful plays come with a cost.

[h2]Playstyle[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Frost & Freeze[/b] — Reach an enemy's Freeze threshold to make it skip an action. Repeated Freezes raise that enemy's threshold, so time your control carefully.
[*][b]Cold Storage & Thaw[/b] — Store cards for later and Thaw them at the start of your turn. A Thawed card costs 1 less the next time it is played. Combine draw, extra Thaws, and supporting Powers to prepare your next combo.
[*][b]Ice Crystals[/b] — Create Attack cards, then strengthen, upgrade, and combine them through dedicated synergies.
[*][b]Ice Armor[/b] — Absorbs damage after Block and is consumed as it protects you. It naturally melts each turn, rewarding well-timed defense.
[*][b]Snowfall[/b] — Deals non-Attack damage to ALL enemies at the end of your turn, then halves its stacks.
[*][b]Self-Frost[/b] — Trade HP loss next turn for benefits now, and use supporting cards and Powers to manage the cost.
[/list]

[h2]Content[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]94 cards[/b], including starter, generated, Ancient cards, and the new Curse.
[*][b]25 relics[/b], including 16 event-exclusive Void relics, and [b]3 character-specific potions[/b].
[*]Chinese and English localization.
[*]Animated idle visuals, static death artwork, multiplayer treasure gestures, and custom portraits, card art, and status icons.
[*]Card effects and sounds matched to their themes and mechanics.
[*]Single-player and multiplayer support.
[/list]

[h2]Void Cradle and Void Relics[/h2]
A new event available to all characters: [b]Void Cradle[/b]. Touch the orb for a random Void relic, or offer a random eligible relic you own to corrupt it into its Void counterpart. [b]Both choices grant Putrefaction[/b], a 1-energy Curse that loses you 3 HP when Exhausted, with Exhaust and Eternal. You may also leave.

16 Void relics have their own [b]Void[/b] rarity and compendium section. They never appear in ordinary rewards or shops. Obtaining one permanently removes its original counterpart from the run reward pools, and disables that original while you hold both.

[h2]Eclipse Challenge[/h2]
Adds [b]Eclipse 0–8 for ALL characters[/b], with cumulative modifiers to healing, resources, and combat.
Single-player progression is tracked separately for each character. In multiplayer, the host selects one difficulty for the whole party; multiplayer progression is separate from single-player and shared across characters.

[b]Modifiers added at each level[/b] (higher levels include all earlier modifiers):
[list]
[*][b]Eclipse 0[/b] — No special effects.
[*][b]Eclipse 1[/b] — Ancients restore only 70% of your missing HP.
[*][b]Eclipse 2[/b] — Hide the map nodes on the three floors before the first Boss of each Act, concealing their room types.
[*][b]Eclipse 3[/b] — Start with 20 less Gold.
[*][b]Eclipse 4[/b] — At the start of even-numbered turns, enemies gain 3 Block.
[*][b]Eclipse 5[/b] — Healing from all sources other than Ancients is reduced by one third. Positive healing restores at least 1 HP.
[*][b]Eclipse 6[/b] — HP loss from events is increased by 50%. Changes to Max HP are unaffected by this modifier.
[*][b]Eclipse 7[/b] — At the start of odd-numbered turns, enemies gain 1 temporary Strength. Cannot be negated by Artifact.
[*][b]Eclipse 8[/b] — Each time an ally takes unblocked damage and survives, they lose 1 Max HP, up to a total reduction of 50%. Max HP lost to Eclipse is restored at the start of the next Act.
[/list]

[h2]Requirements & Multiplayer[/h2]
Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295]RitsuLib[/url]. [b]Stable game 0.107.1 (public): Frostsworn 0.9.13. Beta game 0.111.0 (public-beta): Frostsworn 0.9.13. Both require RitsuLib 0.6.7.[/b] Separate builds are uploaded for each game branch. Automatic Workshop branch delivery currently has a known issue. If the startup version warning appears, exit, unsubscribe and resubscribe, then restart after downloading; if it persists, use the build matching your game version. All players should use matching Frostsworn and RitsuLib versions. Starting a new run after updating is recommended.

[h2]Settings & Error Reports[/h2]
In RitsuLib's mod settings, open [b]Frostsworn → Error reports[/b] to change [b]Allow sending error reports[/b].
This option is [b]on by default[/b]. Sanitized diagnostic logs from errors and multiplayer state divergence are sent to the author's [b]public GitHub repository[/b] for troubleshooting. No player login is required, and full saves are not sent. Turning it off stops collection and sending; updates preserve your choice.

[h2]Update Plans[/h2]
[list]
[*]1: Fix bugs.
[*]2: Add new characters.
[*]3: Add new Ancients.
[*]4: Refine existing content and adjust balance.
[/list]

[h2]Feedback & Source[/h2]
Feedback is welcome! For bug reports, please include your mod version, Eclipse level, single-player or multiplayer mode, and the steps leading to the issue.
[url=https://github.com/Shikieiki049/Frostsworn]Source code and issue tracker[/url]

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Codex / OpenAI[/b] — Assistance with development, debugging, English translation, image editing, and animation prototypes.
[*][b]Shikieiki049[/b] — Gameplay design, supplied artwork, testing, and feedback.
[*][b]RitsuLib and its author(s)[/b] — Mod framework, settings, and multiplayer support.
[*][b]Mega Crit / Slay the Spire 2[/b] — The game and the native interfaces, visual effects, and sounds reused by this mod.
[*][url=https://tutorials.sts2modding.com/]STS2 Modding Tutorials[/url] — Modding and Workshop publishing guides.
[*][url=https://github.com/ptrlrd/spire-codex]ptrlrd / spire-codex[/url] — Reference game data and implementations.
[*][b]Godot, .NET, Harmony, Steam Workshop, and Cloudflare Workers[/b] — Tools and platforms used to run, develop, publish, and support error reporting for the mod.
[*]Thanks to the players who tested the mod, reported issues, and shared suggestions.
[/list]

[b]0.9.13 multiplayer update: ALL peers must update and fully restart. Do not mix with older builds.[/b]
